tagline: Build the world's most powerful computers to help solve humanity's most important and pressing problems
hero_kpi_rationale: The quantum systems order backlog (Novera, C-DAC) is the primary indicator of commercial traction in an emerging market where QPU and on-premise system sales represent the path to direct monetization.

kpis.name: Quantum Processor Orders
kpis.explanation: Total value of orders received for physical quantum systems (e.g., Novera, C-DAC)
kpis.description: In 2025, Rigetti received $5.7M in orders for two Novera systems. In January 2026, an $8.4M order was received from C-DAC for a 108-qubit system. Total: $14.1M
kpis.signal: Emerging commercial traction with two major orders in 2025-2026

kpis.name: Two-Qubit Gate Fidelity
kpis.explanation: Average accuracy of two-qubit operations, a key processor performance indicator
kpis.description: Median fidelity improved to 99.0% on Ankaa-3 (2024), then 99.6% on Cepheus-1-36Q (January 2026). Prototype reached 99.9%.
kpis.signal: Industry-leading performance: 99.6% on Cepheus-1-36Q in January 2026

kpis.name: Flagship System Qubit Count
kpis.explanation: Number of qubits in the company's most advanced quantum system
kpis.description: Ankaa-3 (84 qubits) launched in 2024, Cepheus-1-36Q (36 qubits) in 2025, Cepheus-1-108Q (108 qubits) in 2026.
kpis.signal: Cepheus-1-108Q (12 9-qubit chiplets) represents the most scalable architecture to date

kpis.name: Annual Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Annual net loss after all expenses
kpis.description: Net loss of $216.2M in 2025 vs $201.0M in 2024. Cumulative: $771.0M as of December 31, 2025.
kpis.signal: Losses increased in 2025, reflecting investments in R&D and infrastructure

kpis.name: R&D Strategic Focus
kpis.explanation: Priority on modular architecture development and gate fidelity improvement
kpis.description: Development of patented multi-chip architecture, fidelity improvements via adiabatic CZ gates and 3D coupling.
kpis.signal: Heavy investment in chiplet architecture and quantum error reduction

kpis.name: Vertical Integration (Design to Cloud)
kpis.explanation: Ability to design, manufacture, and deliver via cloud without third-party dependency
kpis.description: Fab-1 in Fremont produces processors. QCS enables cloud access. Vertical integration is key to scalability.
kpis.signal: Ownership of Fab-1 and QCS cloud platform ensures full stack control

kpis.name: Two-Qubit Gate Fidelity
kpis.explanation: Average accuracy of two-qubit operations, a key processor performance indicator
kpis.description: 99.0% on Ankaa-3 in 2024, 99.6% on Cepheus-1-36Q in January 2026. Demonstrates technical progress.

kpis.name: Flagship System Qubit Count
kpis.explanation: Number of qubits in the company's most advanced quantum system
kpis.description: 36 qubits in 2025 (Cepheus-1-36Q), 108 qubits in 2026 (Cepheus-1-108Q) via modular architecture.
kpis.signal: Jump from 36 to 108 qubits in 2026 with Cepheus-1-108Q

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data security risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in Item 1A of the 10-K, the language is direct and indicates potential negative consequences. This risk is fundamental for a technology company handling sensitive data and critical computing systems.

risks.title: Transition from reliance on development contracts to product sales
risks.score_rationale: Highlighted in the MD&A, shifting from dependence on development contracts to product sales is a major challenge. The strength of the language suggests significant uncertainty regarding the ability to monetize innovations.

risks.title: Significant operating losses and need for future financing
risks.score_rationale: Substantial losses ($216.2M in 2025) and accumulated deficits ($771.0M cumulative) are clearly stated in financial statements. The mention of potential future funding needs underscores the severity of capital risk.

risks.title: Economic volatility and impact on access to capital
risks.score_rationale: Described in detail in the 'Macroeconomic Considerations' section of the MD&A, this risk is presented as potentially affecting access to capital and stock value. The language is cautious regarding future predictions.

risks.title: Technological development and quantum system performance
risks.score_rationale: Performance and continuous improvement of quantum systems (gate fidelity, error rates, qubit count) are central to the business strategy. Technical challenges in achieving scalability and computational advantage are implicit.

risks.title: Litigation and legal proceedings risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 3 of the 10-K, the risk is currently deemed immaterial, but the possibility of future litigation is acknowledged. Severity is therefore moderate.

ai_positioning.summary: Rigetti Computing, Inc. positions itself as a leader in superconducting quantum computing, developing quantum systems and collaborative research services. The company focuses on modular multi-chip processors and vertical integration (design to cloud) to achieve computational advantage.
evidence: Rigetti Computing, Inc. developed the world's first multi-chip quantum processor for scalable quantum computing systems
The company owns and operates Fab-1, a dedicated quantum processor manufacturing facility
Rigetti received major orders: $5.7M (Novera, 2025) and $8.4M (C-DAC, 2026) for on-premise systems
Strategic collaboration with Quanta Computer on components and $250M joint investment over 5 years
